title: run_layout
description: Root descriptor of a simulation run's unified cell tree: <base>/<cell>/<pair>/<config>[/<channel>]/sim_*.db. Written at run start by write_run_layout@Optimization/runschema/sim_manifest.py; read by cells@Optimization/runschema/runlayout.py and analyze_run@Optimization/analyze_run.py so tools INFER the tree instead of directory-guessing.

version.description: version of THIS descriptor's field set

schema_id.description: which run-tree contract the run's DIRECTORY LAYOUT follows: the sha256 of that contract's own declared shape, stored at Optimization/schemas/run_tree/<first-12-hex>.json. resolver_for@Optimization/runschema/__init__.py selects the path resolver from this, so an old run stays analyzable after the tree shape changes. A content address, not a sequence number — derived from the declaration, so it is re-derivable and cannot be mis-assigned.

spec.description: whatif_config.SPECS name that produced the run

reference.description: baseline/round-robin cell for the cross-cell delta

tree_template.description: leaf path pattern relative to a cell dir

pair_bindings.description: version 2 (additive): {pair label -> WHICH catalogue version it resolved to, or null when discovery used the pre-contract legacy walk}. A regenerated-in-place catalogue mints new params digests, so a recorded binding makes silent re-pointing detectable after the fact. Written by _pair_bindings@Optimization/runschema/sim_manifest.py from the catalogue's own profile_layout.json.
